text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: page fired PD-3456 - inference-high-latency (sev=P1) -> https://pd.example/PD-3456
incidentbot: Affected: us-east inference pool. Trigger: 95th pct latency > 3s for 5m.
bob_s: acked and oncall -> looking now :eyes:
bob_s: quick check - is this correlated with the model rollout from 03:12?
alice_m: yep we started rolling model v2.3.1 at ~03:10, but rollback didn't start. seeing more KV cache evictions since rollout.
charlie: FYI metrics: tail latency spike aligns with increased batch size and cache miss rate, redis evictions spiked.
dana: I'm running a quick scale up on dedicated pool (raising min nodes). Command: `rgctl pool update --name=inference-us-east --min=3`
charlie: running `redis-cli INFO stats | grep evicted` shows evicted_keys: 1245 in last 10m
bob_s: opening bridge -> incidentbot: please post bridge link
incidentbot: Bridge created: https://meet.example/bridge/PD-3456 - join to coordinate
sre_lead: on the bridge. Bob, if you need to handoff, call it now. I'll coordinate customer comms.
dana: scale-up completed, pool min=3. Autoscaler logs show new nodes provisioning (EC2).
alice_m: reverting model rollout to v2.3.0 now on k8s -> `kubectl set image deploy/infer-service infer=model:v2.3.0 --namespace=prod`
charlie: after scale and revert, 95th pct decreased from 4.8s -> 1.1s within ~2m. cache misses trending down.
bob_s: nice, I'm taking ownership to follow through until stable. Bob -> owning PD-3456 (handing off from oncall) :white_check_mark:
alice_m: I'll monitor model gradients and correctness checks for a bit. If stable, we can reattempt rollout with smaller batch size.
sre_lead: customer impact note: some customers (subset of embeddings batch jobs) saw delayed responses ~30-60s. No failed requests, just high latency. Preparing a short update to ops-customer-updates.
bob_s: posting update: "Resolved: rollout reverted and pool scaled; latency normalized. Investigating root cause (KV cache eviction + rollout batch config)."
dana: adding autoscaler tweak: lower target batch size and increase cache TTLs. will push followup PR.
charlie: logging note: saving relevant traces -> `/var/log/ingest/PD-3456-trace.log` and capturing redis dump.
sre_lead: good. We'll keep the bridge open for 30m. Bob to write the incident ticket and I'll own the postmortem.
bob_s: will create ticket and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml. ETA ticket in 10m.
alice_m: :thumbsup: thanks everyone.
incidentbot: PD-3456 status updated -> acknowledged by bob_s, status: mitigated, bridge open, follow-up assigned.
